commits.author: Tim Grafford
commits.message:
feat: Add support for Spring Boot 4 (#65)

BREAKING CHANGE: Library no longer works with Spring Boot 3.

Spring Boot upgraded to version 4.0.3. This changeset includes:

 - Upgraded Gradle to v8.14.3
 - Use the renamed module dependencies from Spring Boot 4
   - This introduced some minor refactoring related to interface
     and package structure of classes used
 - Introduce testing dependencies for each module included
 - Make use of JSpecify null-safety (introduced in Spring Boot 4)
   - This also included some minor refactoring where possible
     null-values were not handled as expected

Fixes: #59

Signed-off-by: Tim Grafford <tim@grafford.dev>

commits.author: Philip Conrad
commits.message:
chore: Refactors and cleanups. (#50)

* chore: Refactors and cleanups.

This commit is a systematic cleanup of older references to Styra
properties.

Refactors and changes:
 - com.styra.XX -> org.openpolicyagent.XX
 - com/styra/... -> org/openpolicyagent/...
 - Mass move of /com/styra/... files -> /org/openpolicyagent/...
 - github.com/StyraInc -> github.com/open-policy-agent
 - Manual retargeting of Styra SDK docs links to this repo's `docs/` folder.
 - docs.styra.com links removal.
 - styrainc.github.io URLS -> open-policy-agent.github.io
 - LICENSE authors updated.
 - "Enterprise OPA" -> "EOPA". Misc cleanups.

Signed-off-by: Philip Conrad <philip@chariot-chaser.net>
